name: Ichijouji Teika
source:
2nd year student.
Star Sign: Virgo
Likes: Sweets
Dislikes: Spicy Food

Classmate of the protagonist. 
Called "King" of the star arts, boasting the top singing skills on campus. 
He's cool on the surface but he has a hidden passionate heart. 
Childhood friend and current rival of [url=/c53455]Suminomiya Aoi[/url].
